text: The authors assume the weak teacher's error rate alpha_i on each covered class subset S_i satisfies 0 < alpha_i < 1/2, and that the goal is to upper bound the student's true error over the whole input space for classifiers that (approximately) minimize error on the non-abstaining weak labels. They stress that the pseudolabeler and the true labels are both deterministic functions of the input, so its errors are not captured by noise models such as class-conditional or Tsybakov noise, and that training uses only the covered set.
title: Assumption: deterministic pseudolabeler with abstention, class error rate below 1/2
